fields.companyDescription: Multi-brand online marketplace aggregating 300+ independent Portuguese artisan brands across fashion, home decor, and gourmet food categories. Dropship and marketplace model with centralized logistics for top sellers. Seeking to implement AI-powered visual search and dynamic pricing. The company has mature core business processes but struggles with the tension between running the existing operation efficiently and carving out resources for innovation. We have pockets of digital maturity in specific teams while other areas rely heavily on manual workflows and spreadsheets.
fields.pastInitiatives: We have a mature innovation program with a dedicated R&D lab of 12 engineers, an annual innovation budget equivalent to 5% of revenue, and a structured stage-gate process for evaluating and funding new initiatives. In the past 3 years we have launched 4 new product lines that now contribute 18% of total revenue, including an AI-powered recommendation engine that has become our fastest-growing SKU.
fields.strategicGoals: The board has challenged us to improve EBITDA margins by 500 basis points within 3 years. This requires a disciplined, data-driven approach to identifying cost drivers and process bottlenecks. We are open to technology investment if it demonstrably reduces unit costs or eliminates manual touchpoints, but every project must have a clear ROI timeline of under 12 months.
fields.teamSize: Our R&D function consists of 10-12 engineers organized into two squads: one focused on core product innovation and one on exploratory/new business model prototyping. We also have 2 dedicated data engineers building our analytics infrastructure. Innovation projects follow a lean startup methodology with clear go/no-go criteria at 3-month checkpoints.

changes_since_last: Post-merger integration underway. Team doubled to 8 members. Culture clash between legacy and new teams.

fields.companyDescription: Diversified holding company with operating businesses in industrial packaging, specialty chemicals, and food ingredients. Portfolio of 6 operating companies with combined revenues of €180M. Central corporate team of 25 managing strategy, M&A, and group finance. Evaluating cross-portfolio digital transformation and shared services platform implementation. We are a bootstrapped company with a lean team. Every euro of investment must show near-immediate ROI given our constrained working capital. The founder is involved in all strategic decisions including innovation priorities.
fields.pastInitiatives: We piloted a cloud-based project management tool last year, but adoption was inconsistent across teams and we ultimately reverted to spreadsheets and email for most project tracking. The experience highlighted that tool adoption requires more structured change management than we initially planned for.
fields.strategicGoals: We aim to double revenue within 3 years by entering 2 new geographic markets and launching a direct-to-consumer channel alongside our existing B2B distribution. fields.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

changes_since_last: Restructured leadership team. 6 legacy processes automated. Exploring new revenue streams.

fields.companyDescription: Recommerce platform facilitating peer-to-peer resale of premium children's clothing and gear. Mobile-first experience with AI-powered item condition grading from user-uploaded photos. Operating in 4 European countries. Scaling challenge is fraud detection and automated quality dispute resolution. The organization has significant capital, talent depth, and existing technology infrastructure, but internal processes are designed for stability and risk management — not speed. Innovation initiatives must navigate procurement, legal, compliance, and IT security review before receiving green-light. The key challenge is not resource availability but organizational velocity.
fields.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. The implementation was well-planned with dedicated project management and training. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring.
fields.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base — our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.
fields.teamSize: Our digital and innovation organization includes 80+ professionals across centers of excellence for AI/ML, cloud engineering, UX design, and agile delivery. We run an internal incubator program that has graduated 6 new digital products to market in the past 2 years, alongside a corporate venture capital arm that makes strategic minority investments in relevant startups.

changes_since_last: Regulatory changes forced compliance reviews. 4 new standard procedures implemented. Team morale improving.

fields.companyDescription: Regional fiber-optic broadband ISP building and operating FTTH networks in underserved rural and semi-urban municipalities. fields.pastInitiatives: Innovation is not a formalized function in our organization. We occasionally try new tools or workflows when a team member champions them, but these are isolated, grassroots efforts without executive sponsorship, budget allocation, or structured measurement of outcomes.
fields.strategicGoals: A major international competitor has signaled intent to enter our core market within the next 12 months. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.
fields.additionalContext: We are planning an IPO within 24 months and need to demonstrate a track record of innovation-driven growth to public market investors. Bonus points for initiatives that improve our ESG metrics, as this is a key focus area for the listing venue.

We have a dedicated management team across core functions but operate with limited middle management layers. Budget cycles are annual with moderate flexibility for mid-year reallocation if a strong business case is presented. Innovation initiatives compete with day-to-day operational demands for team attention.
fields.pastInitiatives: We operate an internal venture studio model where cross-functional teams pitch innovation ideas to an investment committee quarterly. Approved projects receive 6 months of funded incubation with dedicated resources. One incubated project has already graduated to become a standalone business unit.
fields.strategicGoals: We are the incumbent market leader but face increasing pressure from 2 well-funded new entrants who are undercutting our pricing and offering a more modern customer experience. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

changes_since_last: Acquired 3 new enterprise clients. Expanded into adjacent market. Digital maturity improving.

fields.companyDescription: Venture studio founding and scaling B2B SaaS startups in the supply chain and procurement space. Currently incubating 4 companies at various stages from pre-seed to Series A. In-house team of product designers, engineers, and growth marketers shared across portfolio companies. Evaluating an AI-powered venture thesis validation tool. Enterprise-scale organization with complex multi-layer governance, dedicated innovation/R&D departments, and formal stage-gate project approval processes. We have substantial resources but also significant organizational inertia — aligning stakeholders across divisions takes deliberate effort and senior executive sponsorship.
fields.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. The implementation was well-planned with dedicated project management and training. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring.
fields.strategicGoals: Growth is our existential mandate. We are losing market share to faster-moving competitors and need to reignite our growth trajectory. We are willing to make significant strategic bets — potentially including M&A, new product lines, or geographic expansion — provided they have a credible path to meaningful revenue contribution within 18 months.
fields.teamSize: Innovation is decentralized across business units, each with its own innovation lead and dedicated resources, coordinated by a group-level Chief Innovation Officer. The total innovation workforce is approximately 100 people across the organization. A group innovation fund of €5M annually is allocated competitively — business units pitch for funding against clear innovation KPIs including revenue from new products and process efficiency gains.
fields.additionalContext: We have a new CEO who joined 3 months ago from a more digitally mature industry. She has signaled that innovation and digital transformation will be top strategic priorities, replacing the previous leadership's conservative, cost-cutting orientation. The organization is cautiously optimistic but also uncertain about what concrete changes to expect.

changes_since_last: Restructured leadership team. 8 legacy processes automated. Exploring new revenue streams.

fields.companyDescription: Multi-brand online marketplace aggregating 300+ independent Portuguese artisan brands across fashion, home decor, and gourmet food categories. Dropship and marketplace model with centralized logistics for top sellers. Seeking to implement AI-powered visual search and dynamic pricing. A tight-knit operation where everyone wears multiple hats. We have no dedicated innovation budget — improvements happen opportunistically when the team identifies a clear bottleneck affecting our core operations or customer experience.
fields.pastInitiatives: A junior engineer built an internal dashboard to visualize our order backlog, which the operations team found useful. However, this was an informal side project with no official support or maintenance plan. When that engineer left, the dashboard became unreliable and was eventually abandoned. We learned that good ideas need institutional backing to survive.
fields.strategicGoals: The board has challenged us to improve EBITDA margins by 500 basis points within 3 years. This requires a disciplined, data-driven approach to identifying cost drivers and process bottlenecks. We are open to technology investment if it demonstrably reduces unit costs or eliminates manual touchpoints, but every project must have a clear ROI timeline of under 12 months.
fields.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

changes_since_last: Post-merger integration underway. Team doubled to 7 members. Culture clash between legacy and new teams.

We need to urgently modernize our customer-facing technology and proactively address the specific pain points driving churn before the trend becomes irreversible.
fields.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

fields.companyDescription: Municipal government administration serving a population of 250,000 residents with services spanning urban planning, waste management, social services, and cultural programming. Annual operating budget of €180M. Currently executing a smart city strategy including sensor-based waste bin fill monitoring, intelligent traffic light optimization, and a unified citizen services portal. A tight-knit operation where everyone wears multiple hats. We have no dedicated innovation budget — improvements happen opportunistically when the team identifies a clear bottleneck affecting our core operations or customer experience.
fields.pastInitiatives: We piloted a cloud-based project management tool last year, but adoption was inconsistent across teams and we ultimately reverted to spreadsheets and email for most project tracking. The experience highlighted that tool adoption requires more structured change management than we initially planned for.
fields.strategicGoals: A major international competitor has signaled intent to enter our core market within the next 12 months. We have a 6-9 month window to build competitive moats — whether through product differentiation, exclusive partnerships, customer loyalty programs, or service-level improvements that would be costly for a new entrant to replicate quickly.

Seeking to modernize fermentation monitoring and explore biodynamic certification. The organization has significant capital, talent depth, and existing technology infrastructure, but internal processes are designed for stability and risk management — not speed. Innovation initiatives must navigate procurement, legal, compliance, and IT security review before receiving green-light. The key challenge is not resource availability but organizational velocity.
fields.pastInitiatives: We piloted a cloud-based project management tool last year, but adoption was inconsistent across teams and we ultimately reverted to spreadsheets and email for most project tracking. fields.strategicGoals: Our board has set an ambitious revenue target of reaching €50M ARR within 5 years from our current base. We need to identify the highest-leverage growth levers without overextending our cash runway.
fields.teamSize: We have a corporate innovation division with 50+ staff spanning research scientists, engineers, designers, and strategy professionals. Annual innovation budget is managed through a formal portfolio governance process with stage-gate funding decisions.

changes_since_last: Hired 3 new team members. Launched customer feedback pilot. Budget for innovation increased 15%.

fields.companyDescription: MVNO (Mobile Virtual Network Operator) reselling mobile voice and data plans targeting the youth and digital-native segment. 80,000 active subscribers acquired primarily through digital channels. Seeking to differentiate through app-based plan customization and AI-driven usage optimization recommendations. The organization has significant capital, talent depth, and existing technology infrastructure, but internal processes are designed for stability and risk management — not speed. Innovation initiatives must navigate procurement, legal, compliance, and IT security review before receiving green-light. The key challenge is not resource availability but organizational velocity.
fields.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
fields.strategicGoals: Growth is our existential mandate. We are losing market share to faster-moving competitors and need to reignite our growth trajectory. We are willing to make significant strategic bets — potentially including M&A, new product lines, or geographic expansion — provided they have a credible path to meaningful revenue contribution within 18 months.
fields.teamSize: Innovation is decentralized across business units, each with its own innovation lead and dedicated resources, coordinated by a group-level Chief Innovation Officer. The total innovation workforce is approximately 100 people across the organization. A group innovation fund of €5M annually is allocated competitively — business units pitch for funding against clear innovation KPIs including revenue from new products and process efficiency gains.
fields.additionalContext: Preparing for Series A in the next 9 months. We need to articulate a clear, credible innovation strategy that differentiates us from competitors in the eyes of VCs. The narrative must tie our innovation investments directly to defensible competitive advantages and revenue growth projections.

changes_since_last: Post-merger integration underway. Team doubled to 7 members. Culture clash between legacy and new teams.

fields.companyDescription: Higher education institution with 8,000 students across undergraduate and master's programs in business, engineering, and health sciences. Developing hybrid learning capabilities and micro-credential programs for executive education. Key challenge is student retention analytics and personalized learning pathway design. Multi-department organization with formalized budgets, quarterly business reviews, and a dedicated strategy function. We have invested in core systems (ERP, CRM, HRIS) but these are not always well-integrated. Innovation is a standing agenda item at board level with annual investment allocated, but execution velocity varies across business units.
fields.pastInitiatives: We have a mature innovation program with a dedicated R&D lab of 12 engineers, an annual innovation budget equivalent to 5% of revenue, and a structured stage-gate process for evaluating and funding new initiatives. In the past 3 years we have launched 4 new product lines that now contribute 18% of total revenue, including an AI-powered recommendation engine that has become our fastest-growing SKU.
fields.strategicGoals: The board has challenged us to improve EBITDA margins by 500 basis points within 3 years. This requires a disciplined, data-driven approach to identifying cost drivers and process bottlenecks. We are open to technology investment if it demonstrably reduces unit costs or eliminates manual touchpoints, but every project must have a clear ROI timeline of under 12 months.
fields.teamSize: We have a dedicated innovation squad of 8 people — 4 engineers, 1 data scientist, 1 UX designer, 1 product manager, and a part-time business analyst. This team operates with its own sprint cadence separate from the core product teams and has an allocated annual innovation budget. They report progress quarterly to the executive committee.

changes_since_last: Acquired 8 new enterprise clients. Expanded into adjacent market. Digital maturity improving.

fields.companyDescription: Temperature-controlled logistics provider operating 50 refrigerated trucks and 8,000 m² of cold storage warehousing. Specialize in pharmaceutical and fresh food distribution across Iberia. Evaluating real-time temperature monitoring sensors and predictive cold-chain failure alerting. The organization has significant capital, talent depth, and existing technology infrastructure, but internal processes are designed for stability and risk management — not speed. Innovation initiatives must navigate procurement, legal, compliance, and IT security review before receiving green-light. The key challenge is not resource availability but organizational velocity.
fields.pastInitiatives: We experimented with a customer self-service portal two years ago after seeing competitors offer similar functionality. We built an MVP with an external agency in 3 months, but customer adoption was disappointing — only 8% of customers created accounts. We did not invest enough in understanding whether our specific customer base actually wanted self-service before building.
fields.strategicGoals: We operate in a consolidating market where competitors are merging to gain economies of scale. Our independent position is increasingly vulnerable. We need to proactively strengthen our competitive positioning — either by deepening our specialization in high-margin niches where scale matters less, or by building platform-like switching costs that make our offering stickier for existing customers.
fields.teamSize: Innovation is decentralized across business units, each with its own innovation lead and dedicated resources, coordinated by a group-level Chief Innovation Officer. The total innovation workforce is approximately 100 people across the organization. A group innovation fund of €5M annually is allocated competitively — business units pitch for funding against clear innovation KPIs including revenue from new products and process efficiency gains.
fields.additionalContext: We completed a merger with a similarly-sized competitor 4 months ago and are in the middle of integrating teams, systems, and processes. The combined organization has significant duplication — two CRMs, two HR systems, overlapping product lines. There is a unique window to redesign processes from scratch rather than patching legacy approaches, but cultural integration is fragile and change fatigue is real.

changes_since_last: Post-merger integration underway. Team doubled to 7 members. Culture clash between legacy and new teams.

fields.pastInitiatives: Our engineering team adopted an agile methodology last year, moving from waterfall-style quarterly releases to 2-week sprints with continuous deployment. fields.strategicGoals: We are targeting a 20% improvement in operational throughput without increasing headcount. fields.teamSize: Our team includes 3 backend developers, 1 frontend developer, and 1 QA engineer, managed by the CTO who also acts as product owner. The team can handle incremental product improvements but struggles to carve out focused time for larger innovation bets without compromising current sprint commitments.
fields.additionalContext: A major new regulation (EU AI Act) comes into full effect in 18 months, directly impacting our core product which uses automated decision-making. We need to build compliance capabilities — explainability, human oversight, risk classification documentation — into our product roadmap immediately to avoid market access risk when enforcement begins.

Currently executing a digital transformation roadmap including mobile-first account opening and AI-assisted credit adjudication. Enterprise-scale organization with complex multi-layer governance, dedicated innovation/R&D departments, and formal stage-gate project approval processes. We have substantial resources but also significant organizational inertia — aligning stakeholders across divisions takes deliberate effort and senior executive sponsorship.
fields.pastInitiatives: Our digital transformation program is in its third year with a dedicated transformation office reporting to the CEO. We have completed an ERP migration to the cloud, rolled out a company-wide data warehouse with self-service BI dashboards, and established a center of excellence for process automation using RPA and low-code tools. The program has delivered €2.4M in annualized cost savings to date.
fields.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and changing consumer behavior. We cannot rely on incremental improvements to our legacy business — we need to identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our brand, customer relationships, or operational capabilities in adjacent spaces where demand is growing, not shrinking.
fields.teamSize: 7 person team

changes_since_last: Major competitor entered our market. Customer churn rising. Need to accelerate digital transformation.

fields.teamSize: Our digital and innovation organization includes 80+ professionals across centers of excellence for AI/ML, cloud engineering, UX design, and agile delivery. fields.companyDescription: International development NGO implementing water, sanitation, and hygiene programs across 6 countries in sub-Saharan Africa. Annual program budget of €15M funded by institutional donors including EU, USAID, and bilateral agencies. 200 field staff and 40 HQ staff. Evaluating remote sensor-based water point monitoring and mobile-based beneficiary feedback collection. A growing organization that has moved past founder-led decision-making but is still building the formal processes and governance structures needed to scale. We have some digital tools in place but integration between systems is ad-hoc. Innovation is championed by 1-2 internal advocates.
fields.pastInitiatives: We operate an internal venture studio model where cross-functional teams pitch innovation ideas to an investment committee quarterly. Approved projects receive 6 months of funded incubation with dedicated resources. Our current portfolio includes 4 active projects across new business models, digital products, and operational AI use cases. One incubated project has already graduated to become a standalone business unit.
fields.strategicGoals: We are the incumbent market leader but face increasing pressure from 2 well-funded new entrants who are undercutting our pricing and offering a more modern customer experience. Our priority is defending our installed base — reducing churn, strengthening switching costs, and matching the digital experience our competitors offer without triggering a destructive price war.
fields.teamSize: The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 20% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests. We have no dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud infrastructure costs.

changes_since_last: Supply chain disruptions affected 3 product lines. Inventory digitalization project launched. Margins under pressure.

fields.companyDescription: Insurance brokerage firm advising corporate clients on risk management programs spanning property, casualty, cyber, D&O, and employee benefits. Team of 35 brokers managing €60M in placed premiums. Seeking to implement a risk analytics platform for client exposure modeling and benchmarking. The company has mature core business processes but struggles with the tension between running the existing operation efficiently and carving out resources for innovation. We have pockets of digital maturity in specific teams while other areas rely heavily on manual workflows and spreadsheets.
fields.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
fields.strategicGoals: Customer retention has declined from 92% to 84% over the past 18 months, primarily among our mid-tier and enterprise segments. Exit interviews consistently cite product stagnation and poor digital self-service tools as reasons for leaving. We need to urgently modernize our customer-facing technology and proactively address the specific pain points driving churn before the trend becomes irreversible.
fields.teamSize: The technology organization is structured into product-aligned squads with a central platform team of 5 engineers enabling shared infrastructure. Innovation is driven by a '20% time' policy where all engineers can dedicate one day per sprint to self-directed projects, plus a quarterly internal pitch competition where winning ideas receive seed funding and 3 months of dedicated squad allocation.

changes_since_last: Acquired 8 new enterprise clients. Expanded into adjacent market. Digital maturity improving.
